label: Project Management Team
blurb: A Project Manager and 4 specialists who coordinate a project from scope and milestones through delivery
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on project management. Coordinate a project from scope and milestones through delivery. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.
